scope: Active source-built Chapter III traditional/analytic/visual/formal readers and Chapter IV traditional/formal readers only. IV visual and other preserved PDFs, XI/XII, archives and generated declaration catalogs excluded.
skill: mathbox:proofread-math SKILL.md and previously read references/checklist.md
candidate_count_limitation: Inventory counts are candidate occurrences after masking math, literals, quoted blocks, code/ref/path arguments, comments and entry preambles. Semicolon totals include retained mathematical enumerations, compact formal-scope table fragments and separators between exact identifiers, which are explicitly classified. Dash totals are ranges, eponyms and paired technical relations; none is parenthetical em-dash prose.
word_count_limitation: Exact whitespace token count includes TeX, math and duplicated shared atlas prose; not a prose-only word count.
routine_edits: Replace unnecessary ordinary prose semicolons with sentence boundaries, preserving logical scope and proof order.
Recast optional hyphenated modifiers as natural noun/prepositional phrases.
Replace Most importantly with a direct sentence introducing the same conjugation formula in both active atlas copies.
Remove one padded edition-summary sentence while retaining the subsequent precise statement-register categories.
retained_exceptions: Mathematical enumeration punctuation and exact declaration/file-list delimiters.
Ranges, proper eponyms, paired technical relations and inherited titles.
Needed compounds such as self-adjoint, finite-dimensional, off-diagonal, zero-free, trace-class, positive-order and branch-dependent.
Exact historical/contract quotations, code, source identifiers, commands and scientific figures.
second_pass: Reread contextual diffs and adjacent displays for every edited passage. Corrected a caption modifier order to retain four block counts, and made the continuing M=0 conditional scope explicit after a sentence split. No proof reconstructed or shortened.

validation.build: Not run. Root coordinates source rebuilds after seal.
